Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), Constantinopolis commemorative issue of 330-331, Reece period 17; Trier mint, RIC vol. 7 page 214 no. 523. Obverse description: Helmeted bust of Constantinopolis left, with reversed spear over shoulder. Obverse inscription: [CONS]TAN TINOPOLIS.
